sentences.text: The petitioner seeks quashing of proceedings being RC.15/SCD/90-Cal of 1990 under Sections 120B/419/420/ 467/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code pending before the learned Metropolitan Magistrate, 22nd Court, CBI Court, Bichar Bhawan, Kolkata.

entities.text: Metropolitan Magistrate, 22nd Court, CBI Court, Bichar Bhawan, Kolkata
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that prior to the complaint, a departmental proceeding was initiated against the petitioner which was disposed of on merits.
An initial order of dismissal was passed by the authority which was challenged before the Hon'ble High Court.

Though the single Bench of the Hon'ble High Court at Madras upheld the order of dismissal, the petitioner succeeded before the Hon'ble Division Bench which exonerated the petitioner from the charges leveled against him.

Placing reliance on the authority in Radheshyam Kejriwal Vs. State of West Bengal reported in (2011) 2 SCC (Cri) 721, learned counsel submits that in case of exoneration on merits where the allegation is found to be not sustainable at all and the person is held innocent, criminal prosecution on the same facts and circumstances cannot be allowed to continue.

entities.text: Radheshyam Kejriwal Vs. State of West Bengal reported in (2011) 2 SCC (Cri) 721
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner seeks quashing of the entire proceedings on such ground.
This Court is informed that out of thirty-eight witnesses, nine witnesses have been examined.
The petitioner is directed to serve copy of the application upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 25 th July, 2024.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
